detail: `getHost().with(…)` calls `with`, which no 0.5.0 Comvi host has — and this receiver cannot be proven to be one, so it is left exactly as written: rename it to `.use(…)` by hand if it IS a host (a `with` on something else — a Temporal date, an array — needs nothing)
